The '''''Patriot Fist''''' was a [[Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|''Recusant''-class light destroyer]] produced by the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] for the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]].

==History==
This vessel was built on the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] colony [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Minntooine/Legends|Minntooine]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and participated in the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]].<ref name="ROTSICS" />
